basic_info.description: One Mission Bay Unit 522 is located in one of San Francisco's most desirable and prestigious neighborhood with close proximity to world class dining, shopping and entertainment. The unit is a spacious chic 1bd + den/2 bath home, contemporary finishes with quiet common area views to create a serene escape from the busy city. Hardwood floors throughout the home, and ample closets/storage. The L-shaped kitchen has modern cabinetry and high-end appliances, recessed lighting, central heat & air conditioning, in-unit laundry closet. One Mission Bay residents are provided with top-notch amenities, including 24-hour doorman service; an outdoor heated pool & jacuzzi with cabanas; outdoor kitchen with dining area; fire pits & lounge areas; state-of-the-art fitness center & sauna; resident dining room, game room & catering kitchen; meeting rooms,& reservable guest suite.
